fields.label: Service Sections
fields.name: service_sections
fields.instructions: Add, remove or drag sections to build this service page. Removing a section affects only this service.

sub_fields.label: Eyebrow
sub_fields.name: eyebrow
sub_fields.instructions: Short text displayed above the main heading.

sub_fields.label: Heading
sub_fields.name: heading
sub_fields.instructions: Main H1 heading. Do not include HTML or the highlighted words here.

sub_fields.label: Hero Description
sub_fields.name: description
sub_fields.instructions: A concise service introduction displayed below the H1.
sub_fields.placeholder: Explain the service, key value and expected business outcome.

sub_fields.label: Primary Button
sub_fields.name: primary_button
sub_fields.instructions: Main hero action. Enter the button text and destination.

sub_fields.label: Secondary Button
sub_fields.name: secondary_button
sub_fields.instructions: Optional secondary action displayed beside the primary button.

sub_fields.label: Proof Items
sub_fields.name: proof_items
sub_fields.instructions: Short statistics displayed below the hero buttons.

sub_fields.label: Right Panel Type
sub_fields.name: right_panel_type
sub_fields.instructions: Choose what appears on the right side of the hero.

sub_fields.label: Hero Image
sub_fields.name: hero_image
sub_fields.instructions: Displayed when Right Panel Type is set to Service Image.

sub_fields.label: Form Heading
sub_fields.name: form_heading
sub_fields.instructions: Main heading displayed inside the hero enquiry form.
sub_fields.placeholder: Find Out How Visible Your Website Really Is.

sub_fields.label: Form Description
sub_fields.name: form_description
sub_fields.placeholder: Share your details and an SEO specialist will call you to discuss the strongest opportunities for your business.

sub_fields.label: Form Privacy Note
sub_fields.name: form_privacy_note
sub_fields.default_value: Your details stay private. No spam, just practical advice.
sub_fields.placeholder: Your details stay private. No spam, just practical advice.

sub_fields.label: Contact Form 7 Shortcode
sub_fields.name: contact_form_shortcode
sub_fields.instructions: Paste the complete Contact Form 7 shortcode. Used only when Right Panel Type is Enquiry Form.

sub_fields.label: Heading
sub_fields.name: heading
sub_fields.instructions: Use | where the preview heading should break onto a new line. Example: SEO for Google,|AI Overviews &|Generative Search

sub_fields.label: Highlighted Heading Words
sub_fields.name: highlighted_heading
sub_fields.instructions: Enter words or phrases to colour blue, separated with |. Example: SEO|Google,

sub_fields.label: Card Heading
sub_fields.name: title
sub_fields.instructions: Heading shown at the top of the testimonial card (HTML: .client_heading h3).

layout_v2_legacy_section.name: legacy_section
layout_v2_legacy_section.label: Legacy Template Section (HTML class varies by selection)

sub_fields.label: Legacy Section Type
sub_fields.name: section_type
sub_fields.instructions: Displays content stored in the original Service field group.

sub_fields.label: Source Service
sub_fields.name: source_service
sub_fields.instructions: Choose the service whose original ACF content should be displayed.
